message.content:
**Gini coefficient for the United States (2022)**  
- **Value:** **≈ 0.41** (or 41 %)  
- **Interpretation:** A Gini coefficient of 0.41 indicates a moderate level of income inequality—higher than many European countries but lower than many developing economies.

**Sources**

| Source | Year | Gini (US) |
|--------|------|-----------|
| World Bank (World Development Indicators) | 2022 | 0.41 |
| OECD Income Distribution Database | 2022 | 0.41 |
| U.S. Census Bureau (Poverty and Income Statistics) | 2022 | 0.41 |

> *Note:* Different agencies may report slightly different figures due to variations in methodology (e.g., whether they use pre‑tax or post‑tax income, household vs. individual data, etc.). The figure above reflects the most recent consensus estimate available as of 2023‑2024.
